transforms.name: resize
transforms.description: Resize an image

transforms.name: crop
transforms.description: Crop an image to specific dimensions

params.name: dim
params.description: Crop dimensions as [x, y, width, height]

transforms.name: smart_crop
transforms.description: AI-powered crop that focuses on the most relevant part of the image

params.name: fill_color
params.description: Hex color used when extending the image

transforms.name: rotate
transforms.description: Rotate an image

params.name: deg
params.description: Degrees to rotate (0-359, or 'exif' for EXIF-based auto-rotate)

transforms.name: flip
transforms.description: Flip image vertically (mirror over horizontal axis)

transforms.name: flop
transforms.description: Flip image horizontally (mirror over vertical axis)

transforms.name: enhance
transforms.description: Auto-enhance image quality

transforms.name: monochrome
transforms.description: Convert image to monochrome (grayscale)

transforms.name: blackwhite
transforms.description: Convert image to pure black-and-white using a threshold

transforms.name: negative
transforms.description: Invert image colors (photographic negative)

transforms.name: sepia
transforms.description: Apply sepia tone effect

transforms.name: oil_paint
transforms.description: Apply oil-painting effect

transforms.name: ascii
transforms.description: Convert image to ASCII art

transforms.name: modulate
transforms.description: Adjust hue, saturation, and brightness

transforms.name: compress
transforms.description: Lossless compression of the image

transforms.name: quality
transforms.description: Set JPEG/WebP quality directly (use 'output=quality:N' for new conversions instead)

transforms.name: pjpg
transforms.description: Convert to progressive JPEG

transforms.name: auto_image
transforms.description: Server-side format negotiation — picks WebP/AVIF/JPEG based on Accept header

transforms.name: no_metadata
transforms.description: Strip all EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and color profile metadata

transforms.name: imagesize
transforms.description: Return JSON with the image's width, height, and orientation (no transformation)

transforms.name: upscale
transforms.description: AI-powered image upscaling

transforms.name: redeye
transforms.description: Auto-remove red-eye from portrait photos

transforms.name: blur
transforms.description: Gaussian blur the entire image

transforms.name: partial_blur
transforms.description: Blur specific rectangular regions of the image

params.name: objects
params.description: Array of [x, y, width, height] regions to blur

transforms.name: pixelate
transforms.description: Pixelate the entire image

transforms.name: partial_pixelate
transforms.description: Pixelate specific rectangular regions of the image

params.name: objects
params.description: Array of [x, y, width, height] regions

transforms.name: sharpen
transforms.description: Sharpen the image

transforms.name: watermark
transforms.description: Composite a watermark image on top

params.name: size
params.description: Watermark size as percentage of base image

params.name: position
params.description: Position as [vertical, horizontal] e.g. ['top','right']. Vertical: top/middle/bottom. Horizontal: left/center/right.

transforms.name: border
transforms.description: Add a solid-color border around the image

transforms.name: shadow
transforms.description: Add a drop shadow under the image

transforms.name: rounded_corners
transforms.description: Round the image corners

params.name: radius
params.description: Corner radius in pixels (or 'max' for circle)

transforms.name: circle
transforms.description: Crop image to a circle

transforms.name: polaroid
transforms.description: Apply a Polaroid-photo frame effect

transforms.name: vignette
transforms.description: Apply a dark vignette around the image edges

transforms.name: torn_edges
transforms.description: Apply a torn-paper edge effect

transforms.name: collage
transforms.description: Composite multiple images into a single collage

params.name: files
params.description: Array of file handles to compose with the base handle

transforms.name: animate
transforms.description: Compose multiple images into an animated GIF

params.name: delay
params.description: Frame delay in 100ths of a second

transforms.name: crop_faces
transforms.description: Detect faces and crop to them

params.name: faces
params.description: Number of faces to detect (1-100 or 'all')

transforms.name: detect_faces
transforms.description: Return JSON with detected face coordinates (no image transformation)

params.name: export
params.description: Return JSON instead of annotated image

transforms.name: blur_faces
transforms.description: Detect faces and blur them

params.name: faces
params.description: Number of faces to blur ('all' or 1-100)

transforms.name: pixelate_faces
transforms.description: Detect faces and pixelate them

transforms.name: tags
transforms.description: Generate AI-derived content tags for the image (Rekognition/Vision)

transforms.name: sfw
transforms.description: Detect not-safe-for-work content in the image

transforms.name: caption
transforms.description: Generate a natural-language caption describing the image

transforms.name: ocr
transforms.description: Extract text from the image via OCR

transforms.name: copyright
transforms.description: Check for copyrighted content using PicScout / Getty Images

transforms.name: doc_detection
transforms.description: Detect document edges in a photo and extract a normalized scan

transforms.name: image_sentiment
transforms.description: Detect facial expressions and emotional sentiment in the image

transforms.name: text_sentiment
transforms.description: Run sentiment analysis on a text string (does not require a file handle)

params.name: language
params.description: Language code (e.g. en, es, fr, de)

transforms.name: pdfinfo
transforms.description: Return JSON metadata about a PDF (page count, dimensions, etc.)

transforms.name: pdfconvert
transforms.description: Convert pages of a PDF (reorder, extract, change page size or orientation)

transforms.name: video_convert
transforms.description: Transcode video via Telestream (async — returns a status URL to poll). Use filestack_convert_video tool for proper async handling.

params.name: preset
params.description: Output preset (h264, hls, dash, mp3, etc.)

params.name: force
params.description: Force re-encode even if format matches

transforms.name: urlscreenshot
transforms.description: Capture a screenshot of a web URL (use with a URL as the source, not a file handle)

params.name: mode
params.description: Capture entire page or just visible window

transforms.name: zip
transforms.description: Bundle multiple files into a ZIP archive (chain after a /<handle>/<handle2>/.../zip pattern)

transforms.name: minify_js
transforms.description: Minify a JavaScript source file via Babel/UglifyJS

transforms.name: minify_css
transforms.description: Minify a CSS source file

transforms.name: output
transforms.description: Convert output to a different format. Place this LAST in the chain — after all image manipulations.

transforms.name: store
transforms.description: Persist the transform result as a new stored file (default behavior of filestack_transform_apply)

transforms.name: cache
transforms.description: Set CDN cache behavior for the output

transforms.name: fallback
transforms.description: Define a fallback handle when the source is missing or errors

transforms.name: security
transforms.description: Apply a signed policy/signature inline. Use filestack_generate_signed_url for normal flow.
